Question

Consider the \(L\)-system (and turn angle) defined below:

  • Start: A
  • Rules:
    A > +BA-A--B--A-AB+
    B > -AB+B++A++B+BA-
  • Number of recursions (number of iterations):
    • 5
  • Turn angle
    • 60°

Please use this online tool to generate the pattern using turtle graphics. Choose the matching pattern. (I think the initial angle should be \(270\) degrees to match exactly.)


Answerlist

  • A
  • B
  • C
  • D
  • E
  • F
  • G
  • H

Solution

The correct pattern is pattern A.

  1. Use the first link: https://artockthedino.github.io/lsys.html
  2. Copy/paste the Axiom, Rules, Iterations, and Turn angle.
  3. Click Generate Pattern
  4. Back to the quiz, select the matching pattern.
